twap_value.meaning: computed TWAP value returned by validatePrice()

assumptions: validatePrice() is invoked and the TWAP computation at L86-88 executes.
The report states the TWAP-equals-spot property as a general property, not tied to a concrete caller or transaction.

unresolved.description: No explicit BEFORE precondition is supplied; the self-cancellation is a mechanism, not an antecedent, so no P terms are selected.

limitations: No concrete manipulated-price scenario or downstream loss amount is quantified; the claim is the general TWAP-equals-spot property.
The condition uses a grounded occurrence symbol twap_computed for the TWAP computation event; runtime binding is deferred.
